page_title: Email Me App | AI Voice Notes & Note to Self to Your Inbox

sources.entry: Email Me - Email yourself and much more with just one tap, native on macOS, iOS and WatchOS. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/email-me-notes-in-one-tap/id1090744587?platform=mac)

summary.name: Email Me App
summary.one_liner: Email Me is a note-to-self app that sends text notes, voice memos (with AI transcription), images, links, and clipboard content to your own email inbox in one or two taps.
use_cases: Capturing ideas and thoughts quickly while busy
Dictating a voice memo that arrives as text in your inbox
Saving links, screenshots, or copied text to your email
Sending quick notes from an Apple Watch
Automating note sending with Siri or Shortcuts
Sharing a note as a password-protected link
summary.what_it_does: Email Me lets you send notes, voice memos, photos, links, and clipboard text to your own email address from the app, a widget, Siri, or the share sheet. Voice memos are transcribed with AI so you receive both the audio and a written version. Notes can be turned into shareable web pages with text, summaries, and audio, optionally locked with a password. It supports multiple recipients and an option to send through your own SMTP server. The page describes it as available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro.
notable: AI transcription of voice memos delivered alongside the audio
Siri, Shortcuts, widgets, and share extension integration
caveats: Free to download, but Premium features require a subscription or one-time lifetime purchase
Some features may depend on the device and platform
Prices shown in USD and may vary by region; subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled
